Please solve this issue: Some orders ship incomplete, so we capture only part of the authorization. Add `capture_partial(payment, amount, at)` to `ledgerly/payments.py`: it captures `amount` of an authorized payment, sets `payment.amount` to the captured amount, stores the capture time in `payment.captured_at` and sets the status to `"captured"`. The amount must be positive and at most the authorized amount; amounts with more than two decimals are rounded to the cent.

[ace-0002] helpful=3 harmful=0 :: When a repo has a money helper module (e.g. ledgerly/money.py with to_money/round_money/ZERO), read it first and reuse its helpers for conversions, zero constants, and rounding rather than raw Decimal arithmetic.

[ace-0011] helpful=1 harmful=0 :: For money-moving functions, accept optional keyword-only parameters (idempotency_key=None, approved_by=None) so existing callers keep working; check idempotency first, then state, then amount/approval thresholds, then apply the mutation.
